connector.name: GitHub
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to GitHub - manage repos, issues, PRs, and workflows through natural language.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.githubcopilot.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image github-mcp-server:1.8.0. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the github account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
